Diti
(‘the limited’)
------------------------------------------
In the वेदस् as also the mythological lore देवस् and दानवस् (or दैत्यस्), are always pictured as being in eternal conflict.
Diti and अदिति are two of the daughters of दक्ष प्रजापति (lord of beings) married to the sage कश्यप. दैत्यस् are the sons of दिति and āditeyas or ādityas or देवस् are the sons of अदिति.
Once दिति requested her husband कश्यप to bless her with a son who could vanquish इन्द्र. However, इन्द्र came to know about it and managed to break the foetus into 49 parts. They were born as the Maruts, a class of minor gods.
See also ADITI.
